meaning:
1) to have a bad smell, stink, smell bad
1a) (Qal) to stink, smell bad
1b) (Niphal)
1b1) to become odious
1b2) to make oneself odious
1c) (Hiphil)
1c1) to stink, emit a stinking odour
1c2) to cause to stink
1c3) of wickedness (fig.)
1d) (Hithpael) to make oneself odious
2) (TWOT) to abhor

renderings.kjv: me to make me to stink

renderings.bsb: you have made us a stench
and there was a terrible stench
Since he has made himself an utter stench

renderings.kjv: that they had made themselves odious
